faq.q: How does the development process work?
faq.a: We follow five steps: discover, plan, design, develop and launch, with regular check-ins throughout.

faq.q: How long does a website take to build?
faq.a: Typically 2–6 weeks for a business website; larger applications are scoped after discovery.

faq.q: Do you build custom web applications?
faq.a: Yes. We build custom apps around your workflows, from internal tools to customer-facing platforms.
Yes — updates, security, optimization and ongoing support plans.

faq.q: Can you redesign an existing website?
faq.a: Absolutely. We refresh design, performance and structure while keeping what works.
Mainly React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python and SQL/NoSQL databases, chosen per project.

faq.q: How can I start a project?
faq.a: Send us a message using the contact form and we'll reply with next steps.
